title: MoE ROUTER

intro.headline: Route each token to the right expert
intro.body: A Mixture-of-Experts model has many experts but wakes only a couple of them per token. Click the matching expert before the token hits the floor. 12 tokens per round.

insight: You routed {accuracy}% correctly while activating {avgActivated} of {total} experts per token. A dense model runs all {total} every single time — you used {savedPct}% less compute. In a real MoE a tiny gating network makes that same call thousands of times a second, which is how a 31.6B-parameter model runs on 3.2B parameters of compute.
